# Wanderer

> Wanderer is a free immersion and comfort addon for World of Warcraft Forever. Names leave the heads of everyone around you, a label appears when you look at someone, conversations turn into quiet scenes, and the small comforts you would install a dozen addons for are gathered in one. Free, translated into 10 languages, in active development.

Wanderer is a free addon for World of Warcraft Forever, version 0.40.0 (2026-10-11), translated into 10 languages, made by Jaekco.

## What it does

- How do I hide names above heads and play in immersion? Pick the Full immersion preset and the names above heads go away: players, NPCs, enemies, pets, guilds and titles, each one can be set on its own. Balanced keeps only enemies, Show everything puts them all back, and a reveal key shows every name for a moment. When nothing happens, your interface steps aside and comes back the instant you need it. On a flight everything fades but the chat, and photo mode hides everything with one key.
- How can I see who someone is without names everywhere? Hover a character and a label appears right above their head, in place of the game's tooltip. You see their portrait, their level colored by difficulty, their role, your reputation with their faction and a small health bar. It also shows what matters right now: the quest they give or wait for, your objectives (3/8), what you can loot, skin or mine, and who they are looking at.
- Can quests and dialogues play like quiet cinematic scenes? Talk to a character and the interface fades away, the camera comes closer, and their words appear page by page in a panel at the bottom of the screen. Rewards show their rarity, items you cannot use are in red and you can compare them with what you wear. Space continues, 1 to 9 choose, Escape closes. Hold Shift and you get the game's own window, whenever you want it.
- Can I see at a glance whether an item is better for my spec? Over an item you could wear, one line tells how it compares with what you wear in that place, for the branch you play: "Frost: +12 % better" in green, or worse in red. A feral druid sees two lines, the bear's to tank and the cat's to strike. Each branch weighs the characteristics as players of the classic era do, and the weights are yours: a clear window sets them with the wheel, scale by scale, and imports or exports the scales of Pawn, as Raidbots and the class guides give them. A button on the character sheet opens it.
- One addon to sell junk, repair, loot instantly and fish with a double click? Wanderer can sell your junk and repair at merchants (guild bank first if you like), loot instantly when the game's Auto Loot is on, and let you fish with a double right-click. Trainers get a Learn all button, the mailbox a Take all button. Quests can be accepted and turned in for you, whispers can open in their own window, and game windows can be moved where you want them. Every automation is off until you turn it on, and nothing changes during a fight.
- Can fishing and professions tell a little story? Over the bobber, a label tells what happens: the line landing, the wait, the last seconds, then a short notice for each catch, with the count and the streaks. A pole without a lure is pointed out before you cast in vain, and the music can step back to let you hear the splash. Each profession point comes with a short notice. At the mailbox, Take the gold takes only the gold of your letters, and an innkeeper tells you where your home is and whether your hearthstone is ready. Reminders keep what you must not forget, tied to a place if you like.
- Can Wanderer help in a group, and keep track of what I must do? Hold Shift over a player and the label tells the branch they play with its role, their other branches, their item level and their rank in the guild. In dungeons your companions are named, never you, and a key opens a wheel of raid markers under the mouse. The Stacked and Clean layouts put your group in the game's raid-style frames, sorted by role. Private messages read as a conversation in bubbles, in a window of their own with a button by the chat. Your guild's names float faintly over their heads, your blessings that fade are said to be cast again, and each chat tab keeps its conversations after a reload.
- Can I choose the look and keep my own settings? Six predefined styles dress the label, the game's tooltips and the conversation panel alike. Everything sits in the game's own options (Esc, Options, AddOns, Wanderer), with a live preview, and the game's search box finds it. A welcome screen sets things up the way you play, with profiles per character and per kind of place. Turn Wanderer off and every game setting it changed is given back.
- Does Wanderer work with Total RP 3? Yes. When you hover a roleplayer, the label shows their Total RP 3 name, title and in-character status, right above their head. Roleplay gestures are there too if you want them: your character reads when opening a book or the mail, cheers on level up and waves at the people they talk to.

## Extensions

### Wanderer Bags

Wanderer Bags is a free extension of Wanderer for World of Warcraft Forever. It gathers every bag you carry in a single window, sorts what you carry the way you think about it, keeps what matters safe from a careless sale, and brings your bank along, even far from the banker.

- How do I see all my bags in one window in WoW Forever? Install Wanderer Bags with Wanderer: your bags open in one window drawn like every Wanderer window, following your Wanderer profiles. The squares are the game's own: a right click uses an item, a drag moves it, the tooltips, cooldowns and the glow of new items are exactly as you know them. Sorted by kind, what you just picked up comes first, then gear, consumables, crafting, quests and the rest, the junk at the end, and your free slots fit in a single square. If you prefer, bag by bag, each slot in its place.
- How do I find an item quickly? A search by name or by kind ("quest", "junk"...) lets what does not match step back. The item level shows in the corner of your gear, Wanderer's green arrow marks what is better for the branch you play, and a small coin marks the junk wherever you are.
- Can my crafting reagents be sorted by profession? Yes. Crafting is split into a section for each of your professions, then what your other characters use, then what only other professions use, just before the junk: what you may sell, at a glance. Wanderer knows the recipes, and yours as soon as a profession's window has been opened.
- How do I stop an item from being sold by mistake? Alt+click an item and keep it: a padlock appears, and the item is never sold, neither to a merchant nor at the auction house, until you free it. Kept items gather in their own section, at the bottom of your bags. The same click sets an item aside for the auction house (never sold to a merchant), marks it as junk, or puts it in a section of your own, named as you like. Any section folds with a click on its title.
- Can I sell my junk safely at a merchant? At a merchant, a Sell link sits beside the junk and the sections you may sell, with their value. The game's Sell All Junk follows your marks, so what you keep stays in your bags. With Wanderer Auction or Auctionator, a section also shows its value at the auction house.
- Can I see my bank from anywhere? At the banker, your bank opens in its own Wanderer window beside your bags, with your character's tabs and the Warband's, the game's deposit and sorting; a right click moves an item between the two. Away from the banker, one link of your bags shows your bank as you left it.

#### Questions about Wanderer Bags

- Do I need Wanderer for Wanderer Bags? Yes, Wanderer 0.40 or later. Wanderer Bags is an extension: it uses Wanderer's windows, profiles and item comparison, and its settings sit in Wanderer's options. The CurseForge app installs Wanderer with it.
- How do I install Wanderer Bags? Search for Wanderer Bags in the CurseForge app: it installs Wanderer with it. By hand, download Wanderer and Wanderer Bags from CurseForge or Wago and unzip both into the Interface, AddOns folder of World of Warcraft Forever (_classic_beta_ on most installs).
- Does Wanderer Bags show item levels and upgrades? Yes. Wanderer Bags shows the item level in the corner of your gear and Wanderer's green arrow on what is better for the branch you play, from Wanderer's weights or the Pawn scales you imported.
- Does Wanderer Bags handle the Warband bank? Yes. At the banker, Wanderer Bags shows your character's tabs and the Warband's beside your bags, with the game's own deposit and sorting, and keeps a copy you can look at anywhere.
- Can I get the game's bags back? Yes. One checkbox in Wanderer's options gives the game's bags back, another the game's bank. Nothing else in your game changes.
- Does Wanderer Bags work with Auctionator? Yes. What you keep is hidden from Auctionator's selling list, and what you set aside for the auction house comes first in it.
- Is Wanderer Bags free? Yes, completely, like Wanderer. It is translated into 10 languages, and nothing leaves your game.

Page: https://wanderer-addon.com/en/bags/. Download: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/wanderer-bags, https://addons.wago.io/addons/wanderer-bags.

### Wanderer Auction

Wanderer Auction is a free extension of Wanderer for World of Warcraft Forever. It brings the game's own auction house into a single Wanderer window, with every native feature and comfort on top, and one rule above all: you never sell for less than a merchant would give you.

- How do I use the auction house in a Wanderer window? Open the auction house as usual: Wanderer's window takes the place of the game's, with a link for each page: to sell, to buy, your auctions, your bids. One link brings the game's window back at any time, another returns to Wanderer's, and closing the window closes the auction house.
- How does it choose a selling price? Choose an item and its lowest price is looked up at once; a price just below is offered, or yours matched if you are already the cheapest. What you set aside in Wanderer Bags comes first and has its price looked up by itself, and what you keep there is never offered. A starting bid for items, the duration, the whole stack or a part of it: one click posts it. A right click on an item of your bags chooses it to sell.
- Will it ever sell below a merchant's price? Never. The auction house takes a cut on every sale, so Wanderer Auction compares what you would really receive with what a merchant would give. A price that would bring less is never offered and cannot be posted: the window tells you the least worth asking, or to sell the item to a merchant. The deposit, lost if nothing sells, is shown in orange when it is more than what you would gain over the merchant.
- How do I search and buy? Search by name, or with the game's categories, filters and levels, sorted by price, name or level; your favorites are a right click away. Commodities are bought by the quantity, their total cost said first; items by buyout or by bid. Every purchase and every bid is confirmed before it is made, and what a merchant gives for an item is shown, in green when it is more than its price here.
- How do I follow my auctions and bids? Your auctions show in red the ones that are undercut, and say when following is not worth it. What sold waits in your mail. A cancel shows its cost and is asked first. Your bids put the outbid ones first, a new bid or the buyout in one click.
- Can I see auction prices away from the auction house? Prices seen are remembered for the whole account, with how long ago. Wanderer Bags shows them on its sections, and the tooltips show them over an item, unless Auctionator is there to say them itself.

#### Questions about Wanderer Auction

- Does Wanderer Auction replace Auctionator? No, it is not meant to. It brings the game's own auction house into a Wanderer window, with comfort on top: the lowest price found, a merchant's price never undercut, your marks from Wanderer Bags. It works beside Auctionator, and the game's window stays one click away.
- How does Wanderer Auction compare a price with a merchant's? Wanderer Auction reads what a merchant gives for the item, takes away the auction house's cut from the price you ask, and never offers or posts a price whose net would be lower. It also warns when the deposit, lost if nothing sells, is more than your gain.
- How do I install Wanderer Auction? Search for Wanderer Auction in the CurseForge app: it installs Wanderer with it. By hand, download Wanderer and Wanderer Auction from CurseForge and unzip both into the Interface, AddOns folder of World of Warcraft Forever (_classic_beta_ on most installs).
- Does Wanderer Auction buy or sell anything by itself? No. Wanderer Auction looks prices up for you, but every sale, purchase, bid and cancel needs your click, and purchases, bids and cancels are confirmed first, as the game requires.
- Do I need Wanderer Bags for Wanderer Auction? No. Wanderer Auction only needs Wanderer 0.40 or later. With Wanderer Bags, your marks (to keep, for the auction house) guide what is offered.
- Can I keep the game's auction house window? Yes. An option in Wanderer's options keeps the game's window, and a link beside it opens Wanderer's whenever you want.
- Is Wanderer Auction free? Yes, completely, like Wanderer. It is translated into 10 languages, and nothing is ever bought, bid or posted without your click.

Page: https://wanderer-addon.com/en/auction/. Download: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/wanderer-auction.

## Questions about Wanderer

- How do I hide names above heads in WoW Forever? Install Wanderer and choose the Full immersion preset, on the welcome screen or in the Names page of the options. Every name goes away. Hover someone to see who they are, or hold the reveal key.
- Does it replace my quest window? Only while conversation scenes are on. Hold Shift when you talk to an NPC to get the game's window, or turn scenes off in the options.
- Will it change my game settings forever? No. Turn Wanderer off, or type /wanderer off, and every setting it changed is given back.
- Does it automate quests by default? No. Every automation that acts for you is off until you turn it on, and holding Shift always keeps things manual.
- Is Wanderer free? Yes, completely. It is in active development, and nothing leaves your game: no communication with other players or websites.
- What are Wanderer's extensions? Two free modules that add to Wanderer for World of Warcraft Forever. Wanderer Bags puts your bags and your bank in one window and keeps chosen items safe from any sale. Wanderer Auction brings the auction house into a Wanderer window and never sells below a merchant's price. Each needs Wanderer and has its own page on wanderer-addon.com.
- Do I need Wanderer for Wanderer Bags? Yes. Wanderer Bags is an extension: it uses Wanderer's windows, profiles and item comparison, and its settings sit in Wanderer's options. The CurseForge app installs Wanderer with it. Wanderer works on its own without it.
- Does Wanderer Auction replace Auctionator? No, it is not meant to. It brings the game's own auction house into a Wanderer window, with comfort on top: the lowest price found, a merchant's price never undercut, your marks from Wanderer Bags. It works beside Auctionator, and the game's window stays one click away.
